Bihar Withdraws Protest FIRs After Clashes, Police Firing Incident

Following student protests and clashes related to the NEET exam, Bihar authorities have withdrawn First Information Reports (FIRs) filed against youth protesters. The decision came after widespread demonstrations, including a police personnel being suspended for firing an AK-47 during a protest in Siwan. Opposition leader Tejashwi Yadav had issued an ultimatum demanding the release of arrested students. The protests involved actions like blocking train services.
